# Saved from GPUWorks deployment "working-local-model" (id 1).
# Verified on 1 x A100.
# Local weights company-tuned-model must already be registered on the destination cluster; this template does not bundle model files.
# No placement: the deployment ran on 1 card(s) with 24576 MiB each.
# Missing kv_bytes_per_token for vllm: compute it from config.json
# (scripts/estimate-calib/kv_layout.py) before proposing this template.
# Tested openai.chat: HTTP 200.
models:
    - model_id: company-tuned-model
      source: user
      display_title: company-tuned-model
      input_modalities:
        - text
      model_config:
        architectures:
            - Qwen3ForCausalLM
        model_type: qwen3
        num_hidden_layers: 1
        hidden_size: 256
        num_attention_heads: 8
        num_key_value_heads: 8
        max_position_embeddings: 2048
        vocab_size: 32
        torch_dtype: bfloat16
      context_length: 2048
      specs:
        - name: vllm-1xa100-d1
          scenario: balanced
          engine: vllm
          image: example/local-template:v1
          weights:
            quantization: bf16
            sources:
                - local: company-tuned-model
          weight_bytes: 293
          gpus:
            vendor: nvidia
            name: ^A100$
          args:
            - --enable-prompt-tokens-details
            - --max-model-len
            - "512"
            - --gpu-memory-utilization
            - "0.8"
            - --seed
            - "7"
          api:
            health_endpoint: /health
            operations:
                - request_encoding: json
                  type: openai.chat
                  endpoint: /v1/chat/completions
                  mode: stream
